text:
elena: Heads-up: tomorrow 09:00 PT we will change the default telemetry posture for NEW Private (VPC/on‑prem) installs to telemetry=OFF by default. Customers must explicitly opt in to send usage/metrics. :loud_sound:

elena: This is a privacy-first policy change to align with regulated customer expectations and simplify compliance reviews. It affects hosted agent variants for private installs only, not Hosted API.

samir: Thanks. What’s the migration plan for existing private customers?

elena: Existing installs are NOT flipped automatically. We will: 1) leave current installs unchanged for 90 days, 2) notify customers with an opt-in workflow, 3) provide a one-click/CLI opt-in. Engineer-facing migration guide will be public in /docs by EOD tomorrow.

mike: Can we get a one-paragraph sales-safe summary for GTM and marketplace listings? I’ll need it for partner comms.

elena: Yep — I’ll drop a bullet summary in #product-commms in 30m.

tara_legal: Reviewing the customer notice language now. We need explicit language about what telemetry contains, retention, and support access. Will reply with redlines by EOD.

ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC. Change window: 30m. CI job: onprem-telemetry-default-flag run: https://ci.internal/runs/4321

juniper: Quick ops question: will support debug bundles still be available for P1s? We rely on those for triage.

elena: Support bundles remain available but will be scrubbed by default (PII removed). For a full unredacted bundle, customer must grant temporary support access via the new consent flow. We’ll add a runbook for emergency escalation.

samir: There’s also a new per-customer KMS enforcement toggle in 2.4.1, right? How does that surface in Private?

elena: Correct — Agent 2.1+ and Private control-plane 2.4.1 include "local_kms_enforced" toggle. When enabled: key material never leaves customer KMS, secrets API becomes a passthrough. Docs snippet for operators:

```
# enable explicit KMS enforcement on a private install
redwoodctl private update --tenant <TENANT_ID> --set local_kms_enforced=true

# opt-in telemetry via CLI (customers only)
redwoodctl agent telemetry opt-in --tenant <TENANT_ID> --consent-file consent.json
```

mike: Sales + partners need an internal FAQ. I’ll draft one; please add answers about support impacts and marketplace listing text.

tara_legal: Draft approved with minor wording edits. Legal suggests the following brief line be added to the console banner: "Telemetry is off by default; enable to share anonymized usage metrics with Redwood for performance and reliability improvements."

ops-bot: Runbook pages created: docs/internal/onprem-telemetry-migration.md and docs/internal/onprem-telemetry-rollback.md

elena: Customer comms plan: 1) Email to active private customers (Tue), 2) In-console banner with opt-in button, 3) Changelog entry + KB migration guide, 4) Dedicated webinar for large customers week after.

samir: Adding alerts to dedicated infra so we can watch opt-in rate and any unintended side-effects in first 48h.

juniper: Noted. Will add SLO monitors around agent heartbeats during the rollout window.

elena: Thanks all. If you want to review the migration checklist live, join the sync tomorrow 10:00 PT in Room A. Short follow-ups only.

mike: :thumbsup:
